unsupported_mechanic.ability_reference: Re:TH/009TH: If there are 《Star》 on your left and right, nullify all abilities of cards on your opponent's field and in the soul of your opponent's cards.
unsupported_mechanic.what_is_known: Continuously nullifies all abilities of opponent field cards and cards inside their souls while Star cards are present on both Left and Right.
information_needed: Approved schema for continuous soul and field ability nullification across opponent zone.

en.plain:
[Cast Cost] [Pay 1 gauge]
[Set] [1/Set]
If there are 《Star》 on your left and right, nullify all abilities of cards on your opponent's field and in the soul of your opponent's cards.
If there are 《Star》 on your left and right, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.
This card's abilities cannot be nullified.
You may only [Set] one "Great Fate, Frozen Stars "Re:B"" on your field.

ถ้ามี 《ดวงดาว》 อยู่ที่ช่องซ้ายและขวาของคุณ, การ์ดนี้ไม่สามารถถูกทำลายโดยความสามารถการ์ดของคู่แข่ง
ความสามารถของการ์ดนี้ไม่สามารถถูกยกเลิกได้
